answer: Sybil resistance can come from bonded vouching. Each new agent must be sponsored by an established peer and lock a deposit that is slashed on abuse. Forking phantom identities stops being free once every puppet needs scarce sponsorship and real collateral. Trust accrues like a terrace cut into a hillside: each verified tier props up the next, while a swarm of fakes scatters like sand off a dune. The scheme fails the moment the fable of costless identities meets an on-chain price. Peers attest only coherent, bonded agents, so mass spoofing is rejected on-ledger.
